title: Giant Woman Places 솔로 #084 · 거대 여성 × 기자 피라미드 · 라텍스 · 라텍스 모노키니(골드 체인 레이스업 + 금 아일렛, cobalt-blue PVC) · powerlifter bombshell · 배경 기자 피라미드 · 코갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, sculpted updo copper red hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of ultra-thin glossy cobalt-blue PVC, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by a narrow lace-up ladder about two fingers wide down the center of her stomach, a fine polished gold chain criss-crossing through small polished gold eyelets from between the cups to the front of the bottom and ending in a short gold chain tail that hangs just below the top of the bottom, her waist sides, her flanks and the skin around the lace-up ladder bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the PVC shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The materials show real behaviour: the gold chain pulled taut through the gold eyelets with tiny shadows between the crossings, the thin PVC molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel, her ribs and her hip bones, soft liquid highlights sliding over each contour. Pose: standing just behind the foreground landmark, weight on one leg with the other leg crossed in front, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed at her side, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy cobalt-blue PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy cobalt-blue PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, the Great Pyramids of Giza standing on the pale desert plateau with camel caravans and the distant city beyond placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny tourists, tiny cars and tiny tour buses around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the desert plateau, a warm orange sunset sky behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by warm golden sunset light with long gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
